plan.scope: Fresh visible-only coverage feasibility: one source and one condition,16 times as many unique known-state anchors, fixed10 complete epochs. This pilot uses only e/C/I predictions. The generated small unused test archive is checked for mathematical and orbit integrity but compound predictions are never generated or used for selection. signature.selection_rule: At the fixed final epoch, native e/C/I validation all>=0.95 and generator C/I validation both>=0.90. A passing pilot permits a fresh four-way study; a failed pilot establishes no compound failure claim.
signature.selection_data: Only fresh e/C/I training and validation. No compound predictions or test grades are generated or used.
